RED .118 libwifi-hal/libcld80211 prebuilts are pruned because they shadow LineageOS 22.2 source modules that export compile-time Wi-Fi legacy headers. The package names remain selected so android.hardware.wifi-service receives wifi_legacy_headers and libwifi-hal-qcom receives cld80211_lib.h.

The actual RED 32-bit camera.msm8998 hardware HAL and lower proprietary camera stack remain.
